Ukraine President Dismisses US Ambassador

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has dismissed Ukraine's Ambassador to the United States. The dismissal occurred amid Ukraine's ongoing efforts to secure more Patriot missile defense systems. Olga Stefanishyna was seen holding documents during a meeting, though her specific role in the dismissal or the context of the documents was not detailed in the coverage.
